title: Twinkle, Twinkle
text:
Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star is a famous nursery rhyme. Children in many countries sing it. The song talks about a small star in the sky. The star shines at night.

The rhyme is short and easy to sing. Many children learn it at school. Each line has a simple tune. The song helps young children learn English words.

questions.text: What does the song talk about?
options: a small star in the sky

questions.text: Where do many children learn the rhyme?
Why is the rhyme good for young children?
options: It helps them learn English words
It is sung only at night

questions.text: How do children probably feel when they sing the rhyme?

vocabulary.definition: a short poem or song with words that end with the same sound
gives out or reflects bright light

paragraph_translations: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star to znana rymowanka dla dzieci. Dzieci w wielu krajach ją śpiewają. Piosenka opowiada o małej gwieździe na niebie. Gwiazda świeci w nocy.
Rymowanka jest krótka i łatwa do zaśpiewania. Wiele dzieci uczy się jej w szkole. Każdy wers ma prostą melodię. Piosenka pomaga małym dzieciom uczyć się angielskich słów.
